title.narrative: Early lifesaving response to communities projected to be most affected by El Nino induced riverine flooding in Dollow , Gedo Region.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="text-align: justify"gtThe project will seek to improve access to food security and reduce vulnerabilities targeting 900 vulnerable and El-nino floods (at-risk) households (5,400 beneficiaries), in Dollow district by providing unconditional cash transfer of US $ 80 per direct beneficiary per month for three month period (November 2023 - January 2024). ltspan lang="EN-US"gtIt will provide early response, save lives and cushion them against the food security vulnerabilitieslt/spangt. It will achieve this by participatorily identifying 900 heads of households from 7 villages/communities considered to be at high risk of flooding and have high food insecurity and vulnerability rate. The project targeted villages and number of direct beneficiaries are Uunsi wenye (132) Dayah (125) Wareyle (128) Surguduud (117) Unna (115) Dhumadhumay (..has an IDP QANSAXLEY 109) and Dolow town (174) lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltp style="text-align:justify"gtltbrgtlt/pgt
ltp style="text-align:justify"gtGEWDO will work with traditional leaders, local chiefs, women groups, the local authority, people living with disabilities, marginalized community, minority groups and other local actors to identify the vulnerable communities and enroll them into the programme. The project will be preceded by consultations from the local community, building common understanding, partnerships, confidence and buy-in from the wider cross-sections of the community and all stakeholders to strengthen ownership. GEWDO will work with the local mobile companies to help the targeted beneficiaries (who may not have the mobile lines) to acquire cash-enabled mobile lines that can accept direct money transfer wallet. Using bulk direct cash transfer modality from the bank to beneficiaries will foster efficiency, accountability, monitoring and transparency. it will also reduce transaction charges. ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
ltp style="text-align:justify"gtGEWDO will generate and validate the beneficiaries identities, names and mobile numbers to ensure the details contained in the official beneficiaries list is the same as the one registered in the mobile phone numbers. The organization will initiate processes of cash transfer from the back ahead of time to ensure compliance with all the necessary requirements of accountability but also to primarily meet the livelihood needs of the identified communities on time.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
ltp style="text-align:justify"gtGEWDO will provide the targeted 900 beneficiaries with USD 80 per person per month ltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtfor 3 rounds that will start in 25th lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtOctober 2023 with post distribution lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtmonitoring and evaluation after every entitlementlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt. GEWlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtDO will work with the local actors, especifically SHF partners in Dolow like Trocaire, JF, NAPAD and SEDHURO to build synergy, avoid overlaps and strengthen coordination. It will participate in cluster meetinlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtgs and provide 4Ws information within the greater coordination frameworks.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="text-align:justify"gt ltspan style="line-height: 107% font-family: Calibri, sans-serif"gtGEWDO will strengthen communication and feedback mechanism in the project. Through provision of a feedback mobile line and assigning a person at the M E office, the organization will be able to receive feedback from the communities and respond appropriately as need arises. Issues raised will be addressed with urgency and credibility. GEWDO will also work with local chiefs and leaders in each community who will be able to act as champions of the project, explaining the project details to community, building partnerships and support across the community.ltbrgt ltbrgt The project will also be implemented using the rights-based approach Do-No-Harm and protection principles. GEWDO will ensure the safety and dignity of beneficiaries are protected, privacy are guaranteed while conducting monthly analysis of feedbacks from the beneficiaries to identify any gap that may violate the rights of the beneficiaries. The organization will work with other partners in the same area to address any psychosocial need of beneficiaries considering that the project is panned to be implemented in response to El-nino rainfall, where some beneficiaries who are displaced may need counselling and other services.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgt
